literal: There is no fault in him, even though, sulking is capable of (increasing) the manner of his bestowing love.
translation: Even though he has committed no fault, a lover's tiff has the power to increase the warmth of his affection.
modern: அவரிடம் எந்தத் தவறும் இல்லை என்றாலும், அவரோடு ஊடல் கொள்வது அவர் தன் அன்பை வெளிப்படுத்தும் வழியை மேலும் சிறக்கச் செய்யும் ஆற்றல் கொண்டது.
explanation: This couplet highlights the playful nature of a lovers' tiff in classical love poetry. The heroine explains that even when her partner is completely faultless, feigning anger or sulking is highly effective. It has the unique power to enhance and sweeten the manner in which he showers his love and affection upon her during reconciliation. Thus, temporary sulking is portrayed not as a sign of discord, but as a delightful means to deepen their mutual intimacy.
